## isva-p03-v19 — C1

**SUMMARY.** Sāṅkhya's pradhāna is proved by presence, purposed to spirit by denying self-aims; change comes easy again and again for enjoyment. Only person-aim-striving moves ever-maturing primal stuff; own-nature faces downward from root-cause-seeing toward body's ordaining. Karma admitted as possible mover — then the page turns: where is Īśvara's business? Let His change-triggering be conceived for root-nature's rangers. Seed-kitchens need nothing else, as in sprouts. Three-natured pradhāna leaves Sāṅkhya godless. Puruṣārtha-natured acts are conceived efficient by pradhāna.

*Rasa: vīra (confidence) of joined debate — The sthāyibhāva is exultation: the opponent at full strength, then the page turning on one question — where is His business? The vyabhicāri is admiration for fairness before victory. Debate relished.*
